DRAGONFLY_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install dragonfly. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

DRAGONFLY_VERSION.description: Specific version of dragonfly to install.

DRAGONFLY_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading dragonfly binary or archive artifacts.

DRAGONFLY_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying dragonfly available remote releases.

DRAGONFLY_LISTEN_PORT.description: TCP port on which the dragonfly service listens.
